players.product: YTL AI Cloud: GPU cloud on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs (NVLink, Spectrum-X Ethernet) for AI training, inference and sovereign AI, hosted at YTL's green data center park in Kulai, Johor

quarterly_data.signal: Interim financial report: group revenue of RM6,325.3 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, an increase of 14.0% from RM5,548.7 million in the preceding year corresponding quarter; profit before taxation of RM691.5 million, a decrease of 35.5% from RM1,071.7 million. Full financial year ended 30 June 2026 revenue was RM22,022.8 million, up 1.0%, and profit before taxation RM2,398.1 million, down 27.6%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 FY2026 revenue RM6,325.3 million (+14.0% YoY); PBT RM691.5 million (-35.5%); FY2026 revenue RM22,022.8 million (+1.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Data Center became a new reportable operating segment during the financial year as its contribution became substantial. Data Center revenue (colocation services and others) was RM'000 459,390 for the quarter versus RM'000 57,646 a year earlier, and RM'000 867,127 for the year versus RM'000 124,133; Data Center profit before tax was RM'000 244,292 for the quarter versus RM'000 12,709. The report attributes the higher revenue and profit to progressive completion and occupancy ramp-up of additional data halls together with a cumulative catch-up adjustment from the timing of revenue recognition, supplemented by electricity sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Data Center revenue RM'000 459,390 (Q4) vs RM'000 57,646; FY RM'000 867,127 vs RM'000 124,133; Q4 segment PBT RM'000 244,292

quarterly_data.signal: Investment holding activities revenue was higher in the quarter mainly due to the commencement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) cloud services operations; for the full year, revenue following the commencement of AI cloud services partly offset lower interest income and other declines in that segment.

Data Center prospects: of the green data center park in Kulai, Johor, whose capacity the Group plans to increase to 1,200MW, 298MW is already contracted; the Group has currently invested RM10.6 billion in its data center business.
quarterly_data.figure: 298MW contracted; RM10.6 billion invested in data center business

quarterly_data.signal: Data Center prospects: the Group is developing a substantial portion of the Kulai Young Estate into a solar power facility of up to 500MW to co-power the adjacent 600MW green data center park (first phase of 215MWac implemented), plans to increase the park's capacity to 1,200MW, and is looking to expand geographically beyond the Kulai park.
quarterly_data.figure: 600MW green data center park; up to 500MW solar, 215MWac first phase implemented

quarterly_data.signal: The Group is investing in the national AI ecosystem through 70% owned subsidiary YTL AI Labs, owner and developer of ILMU, described as Malaysia's own large language AI model (ILMUChat, ILMU Claw and ILMU Coding); YTL Communications offers ILMUChat pro plans free to all YES subscribers.
